SR-001.justification: An uncaged runner holding PROCAGE_SECRET spawns caged children whose command called env_clear and set A, under passthrough and under an allowlist naming the secret and PATH; both children see exactly A and PROCAGE_CHILD, on macOS and Linux T1/T2. With the clear ignored the test fails with the whole caller environment.

SR-002.justification: The decision returns an error for passthrough whenever the observer failed its check or saw an unknown shape, and keeps allowlists working; both spawn paths map the error to Unsupported::EnvClear before forking (macOS before taking a run marker; Linux at the environment step, which precedes the fork).

SR-003.justification: Arguments, values, program name and working directory containing the marker lines do not report a clear; env_clear does; the self-check passes on std 1.99 (macOS and Linux) and an unexpected shape is unknown.

SR-004.justification: The test file uses only procage::native with no cfg in its bodies, and passes on macOS, Linux T2 and T1.

SR-005.justification: Reading / on T1 is refused naming hd-secrets without options; accept_spawn_masks holds exactly the three constructs; the plan lowers with them listed in its degradations; adding a glob rule is still refused.
